svg.title: Yixuan He — 5,886 contributions
svg.desc: Publicly visible GitHub calendar, 2025-09-21 to 2026-09-20. One glass cuboid per day. Orange tint and height both encode GitHub's five ordinal activity levels, not a linear count scale. Clear low plinths mark zero-contribution days. Exact daily counts remain in this SVG and the adjacent JSON data. Activity is not a measure of impact. Static edition.
